scope: Chest: horizontal/incline/decline presses, flyes, push-ups, dips (chest version), pullovers
Shoulder pressing: overhead/military/Arnold/push press/landmine presses, handstand push-ups
Shoulder isolation: lateral raises, front raises, rear-delt raises/flyes, face pulls, upright rows, rotator-cuff rotations
Back: pull-ups, chin-ups, pulldowns, straight-arm pulldowns; barbell/dumbbell/cable/machine/T-bar rows, inverted rows, mid-back shrugs, scapular work
Biceps: curls of every grip and implement, preacher/incline/concentration/hammer/reverse/Zottman
Triceps: pushdowns, kickbacks, overhead/French extensions, skullcrushers, close-grip presses, dips (triceps version), JM press
Knee-dominant lower body: back/front/goblet/hack/box/overhead/Zercher squats, leg press, leg extension, sissy squat, step-ups, wall sits; lunges, split squats, Bulgarian split squats, pistol squats

Hip hinge and posterior-chain isolation: deadlift variants, RDL, stiff-leg, good mornings, back extensions, pull-throughs, swings; lying/seated/standing leg curls, glute-ham raise, Nordic curl, hip thrusts, glute bridges, kickbacks, abductions/adductions
Core: crunches, sit-ups, leg raises, planks, rollouts, woodchops, Russian twists, side bends, Pallof, hanging work, dead bugs, bird dogs

Calves and tibialis; upper traps, neck and spinal erectors as primaries (shrugs, high pulls, neck flexion/extension, supermans, rack pulls); forearms and grip (wrist curls, reverse wrist curls, wrist rollers, pinches, holds, farmer carries)
Olympic lifts, strongman events, and plyometrics: cleans, snatches, jerks, tire flips, sled/yoke work, atlas stones, jumps, throws (map coarsely by family; these are niche)
